policy.reading: Authored, reviewed example Pinyin is authoritative; no alternative readings or hanzi-inferred tones.
policy.clauses: Hanzi and Pinyin punctuation must align exactly after Chinese/ASCII punctuation normalization; enumeration comma becomes comma. Apply the frozen pronunciation adapter independently to every clause. Preserve model punctuation and spaces between clauses; never apply sandhi across punctuation.
policy.pinyin: NFC, case-insensitive, whitespace word boundaries and apostrophes; explicit ü, attached erhua r and unmarked neutral tones retained. Citation tones receive the frozen adapter contextual sandhi within clauses only.
policy.yi: Preserve 一 in compound-word final position, ordinals, digit strings, numeral-final positions and decimal digits. Before authored neutral syllables, use the matching dictionary base reading only to determine underlying sandhi tone; never replace its authored neutral tone or polyphone.
policy.limits: Reject unknown model phonemes and strings longer than 510 tokens before synthesis; raw-token inference speaks the complete sentence without automatic splitting or truncation. Every MP3 must decode as finite 24kHz mono, 0.15–30 seconds, RMS >= 0.001. No human auditory validation is claimed.

adapter.reading: First slash-separated dataset reading; never infer polyphones from hanzi.
adapter.segmentation: Tone-marked pinyin lexicon, explicit apostrophe/space/hyphen boundaries, one syllable per hanzi (explicit suffix r consumes 儿). Hanzi heteronyms only disambiguate syllable boundaries, never replace pinyin.
adapter.neutral: Unmarked source syllables are tone 5. No dictionary-driven neutralization of explicitly marked lexical tones.
adapter.erhua: Only explicit source suffix r becomes model R before tone; separately written ér stays a full syllable.
adapter.sandhi: Misaki/PaddleSpeech contextual third-tone word rule and two-pass boundary merging (at most three characters, no reduplication merge), fed authoritative source tones. 不 before citation tone 4 becomes tone 2; A不A and A一A middle is neutral. 一 before tone 4 becomes 2, before tones 1/2/3 becomes 4; ordinal 第一 and numeric sequences retain citation tone.
adapter.limits: Isolated vocabulary, not sentence prosody. Source neutral tones preserved, no automatic lexical neutral-tone dictionary. Third-tone phrasing uses deterministic jieba segmentation; not human auditory validated.
